title: GPT is Not an Annotator: The Necessity of Human Annotation in Fairness Benchmark Construction
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark, WinoSemitism, measures antisemitic stereotypes and biases in Large Language Models, grounded in the lived experience of the Jewish community.
findings: All 20 tested language models showed significant antisemitic bias, being more than twice as likely to apply antisemitic stereotypes to Jews than to non-Jews. The models also demonstrated intersectional biases, stereotyping Jewish women and mothers more frequently. Furthermore, GPT-3.5-Turbo performed poorly when used as an annotator to extract these harms from survey data, producing low-quality and hallucinated outputs, indicating it is not a suitable substitute for human experts in sensitive tasks.
